name: Shallum
overview: The name Shallum appears in Scripture associated with multiple individuals, including a brief-reigning king of Israel who conspired and seized the throne only to be swiftly killed and replaced, as recorded in 2 Kings 15. Additionally, Shallum is identified as the husband of Huldah the prophetess, highlighting a connection to prophetic ministry during the reign of Josiah, as seen in 2 Kings 22. Genealogical records in 1 Chronicles trace Shallum as a descendant of Sisamai, situating him within the broader historical and tribal context of Israel. These references collectively illustrate Shallum’s varied roles in Israel’s history, from political intrigue to spiritual significance.
